title: Generate the skill package from site config and deploy it with the ASK CLI in CI
description: A generator writes skill-package/ (skill.json, interactionModels/custom/en-US.json) from the site config: publication name, invocation name, endpoint ARN, example phrases, icons. CI runs `ask deploy` against the skill on each main deploy. The LWA client and refresh token live as an SSM SecureString (Ryan authorises once). Nobody hand-edits it in the console. Gherkin: the generated package is deterministic and passes `ask smapi validate-skill` style checks in CI.
